data.source_title: I work in a hospital transfusion service - do we need to register with FDA?
data.locator: Hospital transfusion service description and 21 CFR 607.65(f) registration exemption
data.source_setting: U.S. hospital transfusion services performing compatibility testing and transfusion.
data.source_period: FDA web guidance accessed 2026-10-10; page does not specify operational study period.
value: distinguish testing/transfusion service from routine collection or component processing
data.source_evidence_basis: FDA states that hospital transfusion services may perform compatibility testing and transfusion; it distinguishes services that do not routinely collect or process products from blood banks that do. Companion FDA computer-crossmatch guidance describes matching donor cells with recipient serum/plasma and SOPs to detect incompatibility.
data.limitations: This page addresses registration classification, not a complete specimen-to-issue SOP, turnaround time, emergency-release policy, or staffing. Local validated procedures and applicable regulation govern actual steps.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Include a blood-product request, specimen/compatibility work, availability/issue decision, and handoff as distinct events; model stock, test duration, and emergency branches only from target-site evidence.
